description.value:
Requirement A single firearm you have carried through at least three encounters.

Give the weapon a name and it starts answering to it. It never fails while you personally wield it, it cannot be disarmed by any effect that allows a save, and any creature that has seen you fight recognizes it on sight. You may have one named weapon at a time; naming another ends this on the first, and the first never quite works the same for you again.

cinderfall.incomplete: "never fails" ties to Failure Range/Gun Failure; "can't be disarmed by any effect that allows a save" has no Immunity-type selector for a specific maneuver class gated on "allows a save" (Immunity's real shape is condition/damage-type/effect-based, not maneuver-plus-save-type-gated); "on sight" recognition is bucket 6 (social/narrative, zero number). This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
